facts.claim: Grose noted in 1750 that the sole English church in Bombay was a neat, commodious, and airy building situated on the Green.
facts.quote: The only English Church at Bombay, and which is full sufficient for any passible congregption of them at it, is a building extremely neat, commodious and airy, being situate on what is called the Green.

facts.claim: Forbes described the single Protestant church on the island as a large and commodious building featuring a neat tower.
facts.quote: The only Protestant Church on the island stood near the centre of the town, a large and commodious building with a neat tower.
